notices.title: A fresh new look
notices.message: Korean Word Quiz has a new design: a cleaner home screen with today's practice up front, a calmer quiz screen, and a new app icon. Prefer dark screens? Turn on dark mode in Settings → Appearance.

notices.title: 2,233 new words
notices.message: Since the last update we added 2,233 reviewed words: 1,850 nouns such as 맞선, 접수처, and 방울토마토, 371 verbs such as 친해지다, 쾌척하다, and 물구나무서다, and 12 adjectives such as 탱글탱글하다. The bank now has 30,242 words: 13,350 nouns, 11,868 verbs, and 5,024 adjectives.

notices.title: 1,000 new words
notices.message: We added 1,000 reviewed words: 850 nouns such as 은하수, 청첩장, and 월요병, and 150 verbs such as 친해지다, 장보다, and 속상해하다. The bank now has 29,009 words: 12,350 nouns, 11,647 verbs, and 5,012 adjectives.

notices.title: Cleaner, more accurate word bank
notices.message: We removed about 3,100 entries that were not real Korean words, took out duplicate verbs that were listed as adjectives, and added about 2,900 reviewed words such as 아들, 소리, and 설렘. The bank now has 28,009 words: 11,500 nouns, 11,497 verbs, and 5,012 adjectives.
